no natural-person or passenger identity, exact building, floor, shaft or device location, access credential or key, live control or dispatch feed, real-time fault or entrapment state, video or voice, vulnerability, security or control configuration, proprietary maintenance manual, private incident narrative, nonpublic legal communication, payment instrument or contract price
